title: 第10章
content_zh:
苏老师跟展颜谈了许久，她回了趟家，收拾东西，爷爷拿着旱烟袋依旧坐在门口。
他老了，脸像松树皮，一个人足够老的时候，有些事，也就比年轻人更清楚些，他眼珠子浑了，可心里跟明镜似的。
“那你跟爸说，我去学校了，现在学习紧得很随便不回来了。”展颜假装被飞虫眯了眼，揉了几下。
钱，钱，钱，多么诱人又令人难受的字眼。这片土地上，人们吃饱了睡，睡醒了劳作，太阳下去，月亮就升起来，喜鹊归巢，蝙蝠就到处飞。春夏秋冬，只要不死，就得干，不外乎想多打几担粮食，多弄几个钱，可钱好难弄啊，一个一个地挣，花起来确是一把一把地流出去，淌水似的。
东家二十，西家十块，两毛钱就能打半瓶酱油，可住进医院，钱就是不是钱了。
一个有字，她跟爷爷都心知肚明，这钱哪里来的，不用说破，说破了寒碜，可又得这么寒碜着。
展颜没日没夜疯学了起来，每天早起，老师带着他们先围着小镇跑一圈，课间练习立定跳远，掷铅球。那些会考没过，也没机会考高中的学生索性彻底不学了，就等着混个初中毕业证，初三格外躁动。
老师单独给一二十个学生开小灶，晚自习下了课，老师不走，在教室熬到很晚。
学校有个小食堂，饭菜便宜，一个大馍两毛，蛋花汤三毛，如果想吃个炒土豆丝，五毛，加肉一块。展有庆给展颜带了土鸡蛋，生的，又拿了半瓶芝麻油和白糖。
“每天早上冲一碗鸡蛋茶，加加营养。”展有庆把东西搁了，也没什么话要问。
展颜主动说起学习：“快体育考试了，到时，我们学校包车拉我们去县里考。”
展有庆不知道考这玩意儿是干嘛用的，干巴巴问道：“你练的咋样了？”
“掷铅球不太好，其他两项都挺好的。”展颜长跑很有耐力，也能跳的远，就是掷铅球胳膊没什么劲。
王静的奶奶赶集也顺道来看王静，她也住校，大家都很拼，老人从兜里掏出个红色的塑料口袋，缠成团，好半天才抖落开，里头是块裹着的旧手绢，手绢展开，才露出几张两毛的、五毛的票子，都是她攒给王静的生活费。
content_en:
Teacher Su talked with Zhanyan for a long time. She went back home and packed her things. Grandpa was still sitting at the door with a dry pipe.
He is old, and his face is like pine bark. When a person is old enough, some things are clearer than young people. His eyes are cloudy, but his heart is like a mirror.
"Then tell Dad, I went to school, and now I'm so busy studying that I won't come back." Zhanyan pretended to be squinted by flying insects and rubbed it a few times.
Money, money, money, what a tempting yet uncomfortable word. In this land, people eat and sleep, and work when they wake up. When the sun goes down, the moon rises, magpies return to their nests, and bats fly everywhere. In spring, summer, autumn and winter, as long as you don't die, you have to work. You just want to get more loads of grain and get more money, but money is so difficult to get. You have to earn it one by one, and spend it in handfuls, like water.
Twenty cents for the East and ten for the West. Twenty cents can buy half a bottle of soy sauce, but after being admitted to the hospital, the money is no longer money.
She and her grandfather knew exactly where the money came from. Needless to say, it was shabby, but it had to be so shabby.
Zhan Yan studied like crazy day and night. When they got up early every day, the teacher took them to run around the town first, and they practiced standing long jump and shot put throwing during breaks. Those students who failed to pass the general examination and had no chance to enter high school simply stopped studying and were waiting to get a junior high school diploma. They were particularly restless in the third year of junior high school.
The teacher worked alone for ten or twenty students, and after the late self-study class, the teacher did not leave and stayed up late in the classroom.
There is a small cafeteria in the school, and the food is cheap, a big steamed bun costs 2 cents, egg drop soup costs 30 cents, and if you want to eat fried shredded potatoes, it costs 50 cents, plus a piece of meat. Zhan Youqing brought Zhan Yan eggs, raw, and half a bottle of sesame oil and sugar.
"Make a bowl of egg tea every morning for added nutrition." Zhan Youqing put the things away and had nothing to ask.
Zhanyan took the initiative to talk about studying: "The physical education exam is coming soon. When the time comes, our school will charter a car to take us to the county to take the exam."
Zhan Youqing didn't know what this test thing was for, so he asked dryly: "How are you doing in practice?"
"The shot put throw is not very good, but the other two items are pretty good." Zhanyan has great endurance in long-distance running and can jump far, but his arms are not strong in the shot put throw.
Wang Jing's grandmother also stopped by to see Wang Jing when she was going to the market. She also lived in school, and everyone was working hard. The old man took out a red plastic bag from his pocket, wrapped it into a ball, and took a long time to shake it off. Inside was an old handkerchief wrapped in it. When the handkerchief unfolded, a few 20 cents and 50 cents bills were revealed, which were all the living expenses she had saved for Wang Jing.
